hook_text: 1 344 seedlings, a R30 000 budget and one greening day. Can you use every tool from two terms?
clip_script: Greening day in Polokwane! 1 344 seedlings at R18 each. Estimate: about R26 000. Exact: R24 192. Trays of 24? Box times 24 is 1 344. The box is 56. Check it: 56 times 24 is 1 344! Rows grow 5, 9, 13, 17: times 4, plus 1. 3/8 are fruit trees: 504. 25% are indigenous: 336. A seedling grows 0,35 m plus 0,6 m: 0,95 m. Every tool, one day!
visual_style: A sunny school field with rows of seedlings appearing in a growing pattern, number sentences written on garden markers and fraction labels on the trays.
mood: Bright and proud, like a community project coming together.
pacing: Fast montage of tools, each with a quick check, ending on the full field of trees.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and work out how many strings 25 flower beds need.
